title: The Three Bands
prompt:
**Scenario.** A counting problem: subtask 1 (20 pts) n ≤ 20; subtask 2 (30 pts) n ≤ 2000; subtask 3 (50 pts) n ≤ 200000. You have a proven O(n²) idea and 60 minutes left. Optimal plan?

**Which approach is the best fit? The program only needs to print the letter.**

**A)** Implement only O(n²) — it passes subtask 2 fully and maybe 3

**B)** Ship brute force for subtask 1 first (15 min), then O(n²) for subtask 2; skip 3 — banking 50 certain points

**C)** Spend all 60 minutes attempting the full O(n log n) solution

**D)** Submit brute force for everything — it is simplest

tests.name: answer
tests.hint: Band-value arithmetic: 15 min for 20 + O(n²) for 30 banks 50 certain points; chasing the 50-pt band with an unproven O(n log n) risks the whole submission.
